title: Switching Technician changes no list until Save & Close
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician off, enrolled at the test location only.
  • Have Work Orders open on Board View for the test location in a second browser tab.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Technician on.
  3. Switch to the Board View tab.
  4. Reload the Board View page.
  5. Switch to the Settings, Staff tab.
  6. Click Save & Close.
  7. Switch to the Board View tab.
  8. Reload the Board View page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window shows Technician off.

Step 2:

  • Technician is on (not saved yet).

Step 3:

  • Board View shows no column for staff member A.

Step 4:

  • After the reload Board View still shows no column for staff member A.

Step 5:

  • The Edit Staff Member window is still open with Technician on.

Step 6:

  • The window closes.
  • Staff member A's row shows "Yes" in the Technician column.

Step 7:

  • The board has not changed yet.

Step 8:

  • After the reload Board View shows a column for staff member A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S1-R6: “Switching Technician on or off changes nothing until the user saves the staff member with the window's existing Save. Once saved, the change applies to every technician list (Story 3) the next time each list loads (S1-E3).”
  • S1-E3: “A screen that is already open when a staff member's Technician toggle is saved keeps its lists until it loads them again; nothing is pushed to open screens. A work order's technician dropdowns show the change once the work order is opened again or the page is reloaded; reopening a dropdown on the same page does not. Board View and Tech View show it when opened from the menu, a link or the display switcher, when the filter or location changes, or on reload; coming back with the browser's Back within 30 seconds shows the board as it was. The Assign / Reassign lead technician window shows it every time it opens.”
  • S3-R2: “Board View gives a column, and Tech View a group, to each person offered by S3-R1, plus everyone who leads work shown on the board (S3-E1, S3-E2).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "2 Turn Technician on for a staff member", pictures "Switched on" (This build) and "Saved" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p2-06-after-switched-on.png
  • tt-p2-07-after-saved.png

The design's own words:

  • “Switched on, not saved yet. Nothing changes until Save & Close. Turning it on never shows a warning and never logs her out.”
  • “The staff list, filtered to Parts Manager, now shows Technician Yes. Billable stays No: Technician never changes Billable.”

The staff window's existing save button is labelled Save & Close (register TT-D05, settled by S1-R6).
